posts.zh:
dsh-web-default-session 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。点「新会话」默认打开绑定宿主启动目录的「默认目录」工作区（无需选文件夹），工作区选择菜单中也可选该项。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-470d635937485f3e71fa.html
posts.en:
dsh-web-default-session is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. The generic New Session action opens a default-directory workspace instead of requiring a folder pick, and the workspace picker lists that workspace as a no-folder choice.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-470d635937485f3e71fa.html
